g.text: Where the five roots are, on each platform
A single-folder profile of an older
F1R3Gaze at DIR is migrated in place.
A relative or empty XDG value is ignored, as the
specification requires, and the default is used.
Folders F1R3Gaze creates are 0700; files under
data, state, backups and runtime are 0600.
wallets, keys, permissions, site data, trust records, replay logs
